items.t: Supports raising the corporate tax rate, increasing taxes on the highest earners, and eliminating loopholes like Carried Interest.
items.q: By raising the corporate tax rate, increasing taxes on the highest earners, and eliminating loopholes like Carried Interest, we can finance the most effective tax breaks for working people

items.t: Supports raising the cap on Social Security taxation to stabilize the trust fund.
items.q: It is time to raise the cap on Social Security taxation to stabilize the trust fund and guarantee that Social Security will be truly secure for generations.

items.t: Supports a permanent expansion of the Child Tax Credit.
items.q: That includes things like the permanent expansion of the Child Tax Credit

items.t: Supports the Affordable Loans for Students Act, which would retroactively cap all current and future student loans at 2%.
items.q: One bill I would fight for is the Affordable Loans for Students Act, which would retroactively cap all current and future student loans at 2%.

items.t: Supports restricting qualified immunity for federal agents by amending section 1983 of the civil rights act to explicitly include all federal agents.
items.q: Restrict qualified immunity for federal agents by amending section 1983 of the civil rights act to explicitly include all federal agents

items.t: Supports resetting student loans to their original principal amounts and forgiving all loans, graduate or undergraduate, after twenty years.
items.q: And I’ll fight for a reset of student loans to their original principal amounts and ensure that all loans, whether graduate or undergraduate, are forgiven after twenty years.

items.t: Said he fought at the MN Capitol for funding the Dakota County SMART center for best practices training and opposed cuts to police staff.
items.q: funding the Dakota County SMART center for best practices training, opposing cuts to police staff.

items.t: Supports holding law-enforcement officers accountable when they use unnecessary force or violate due process.
items.q: When someone in uniform uses unnecessary force, or violates due process, they must be held accountable.

items.t: Supports ending all U.S. military aid and weapons sales to Israel and ultimately negotiating a two-state solution.
items.q: The United States must end all military aid and weapons sales to Israel to send a clear signal to the Israeli government

items.t: Supports ending U.S. military aid and weapons sales to Israel, permitting humanitarian aid to Gaza, and retracting illegal settlements in Palestinian territories.
items.q: end all military aid and weapons sales to Israel to send a clear signal to the Israeli government, and ensure Israel fulfills all its obligations in the recently negotiated peace agreement with Palestinians, permit all necessary humanitarian aid to Gaza, rebuild Gaza and the surrounding areas destroyed by Israel’s attacks, retract illegal settlements in Palestinian territories

items.t: Supports legislation requiring disclosure of campaign donations by corporations and PACs, and supports a fully funded public financing system for political campaigns.
items.q: Create legislation to require disclosure of campaign donations by corporations and PACS - Create an effective and fully funded public financing system for political campaigns

items.t: Said he has rejected campaign funding from AIPAC, super PACs, health insurance PACs, and corporate PACs.
items.q: My campaign is powered by people, not AIPAC, not super PACs, health insurance PACs, and certainly not corporate PACs like big oil and big pharma. Our elections and our politicians shouldn’t be bought and paid for. That’s why I’ve rejected big PAC money, AIPAC money

items.t: Supports overturning US vs. Shilling, the Supreme Court’s decision to allow the military to ban transgender people from serving.
items.q: Overturn US vs. Shilling, the Supreme Court’s decision to allow the military to ban transgender people from serving.
